modeling_role: Defines why the model exists and what decision or interpretation it supports
review_requirement: State whether the model is exploratory predictive explanatory diagnostic optimization-oriented or governance-supporting
responsible_use_warning: A model built for exploration should not be used as final decision authority without further validation

modeling_role: Distinguishes descriptive predictive explanatory causal and decision-support claims
review_requirement: Match claim strength to evidence strength
responsible_use_warning: Do not communicate stronger claims than the model can support

modeling_role: Defines what the model preserves and what it simplifies
review_requirement: Document linearity low-rank aggregation scaling or state-space approximation choices
responsible_use_warning: Approximation is useful only when its losses are visible

modeling_role: Separates data model numerical sampling and interpretive uncertainty
responsible_use_warning: A precise number can still be uncertain if assumptions or data are fragile

modeling_role: Records where the model has been checked and where it has not
review_requirement: Preserve validation evidence reference cases residual diagnostics and operating ranges
responsible_use_warning: Validation in one context does not automatically transfer to another

modeling_role: Tests whether conclusions depend on data assumptions scaling representation or model form
review_requirement: Compare reasonable alternative workflows when conclusions matter
responsible_use_warning: Fragile conclusions should be communicated with caution

modeling_role: Defines what outputs can and cannot responsibly mean
review_requirement: Attach interpretation limits to generated reports and decision-support artifacts
responsible_use_warning: Do not let computational output exceed the model evidence

modeling_role: Defines who reviews maintains challenges updates and retires the model
review_requirement: Assign ownership review status revision procedures and stop-use conditions
responsible_use_warning: A model without accountability should not silently guide consequential decisions
